DifficultyDesc: Elites and Boss Enemies will enter Berserk state earlier in battle, and the effects of the Berserk state will be enhanced.
Elites and Boss enemies will have their Toughness slightly increased. Every time monsters in the Berserk state get attacked, their action is Advanced Forward.
During the boss fight in the Third Plane, Resonance Extrapolation will additionally possess a Formation Extrapolation.
Phase 3 for the Boss of the Second Plane is Enhanced.
Increases the amount of Cosmic Fragments required to reset Blessings by <unbreak>20</unbreak>.
Initial Countdown decreases by <unbreak>1</unbreak>. The number of Dice reroll attempts decreases by <unbreak>1</unbreak>. Cosmic Fragments decrease by <unbreak>100</unbreak>.
Receive Negative Curios every time you enter a plane.
Blessings from all Paths will be regarded as having been reduced by <unbreak>1</unbreak> respectively.
